title: A server = a connector for one tool

body.text: is a small program that connects one type of tool or data for the AI to use — a server for files, a server for a database, a server for GitHub. There are many ready-made servers to choose from.

example: Install the 'filesystem' MCP server → the AI can read/write files in the folders you allow

title: The AI picks the tools itself

body.text: Once a server is connected, the AI
sees a list of available tools
and chooses which to use for the task. Ask about files and it calls the file-reading tool. You don't direct each step — you just state the goal.

example: Ask 'which file was edited most recently?' → the AI calls the list-files tool and checks dates itself
